requirements.title: ATAN2 result value has bounded and sign-constrained atan2 effects
requirements.definition: The ATAN2 result is in the range -pi through pi; for nonzero X it approximates arctan(Y/X); it is positive when Y is positive, equals Y when Y is zero and X is positive, is approximately signed pi when Y is zero and X is negative, is negative when Y is negative, and has absolute value approximately pi/2 when X is zero.

pending.atan2-range-minus-pi-through-pi: Left pending by intrinsics_16_9_d review follow-up: a strictly portable executable oracle for the exact -pi through pi bound is not available without choosing a processor approximation to pi; weaker enclosing constants such as [-4,4] are not the declared facet.

requirements.title: ATAN2 approximation details are processor dependent
requirements.definition: ATAN2 uses processor-dependent approximations for the principal argument, arctangent ratio, signed-pi case, and pi/2 case.

pending.atan2-processor-dependent-approximation: No portable oracle fixes an approximation error bound or exact bit pattern for the arctangent or pi-related values; future fixtures may test only exact sign, zero, same-result, or broad bounded properties from the source.
pending.atan2-signed-zero-pi-case-processor-depe: No portable single-image oracle can require the negative-zero branch on processors that do not distinguish positive and negative real zero; IEEE-specific tests must be gated outside this source packet.
